name: Clever
description:
You have an uncanny knack for shrugging off the effects of even the fiercest attacks, and you are quick to pick up anything you set your mind to.

Whenever an ability other than your own forces you to make an opposed skill check, your roll is favored.

Additionally, you have an extra pool of 2 MP that can be used for abilities from any Mestiere. This pool is replenished every sunrise, regardless of all other effects.

Describe how this natural affinity for magic manifests in you.
